author: feral-core
description: Control your Home Assistant smart home: list entities, read state, toggle switches, change light brightness/color, and trigger automations. Backend: HomeAssistantIntegration (REST API + long-lived access token). NOT for the CuteBot/QtBot desk robot — that device's headlight/underglow uses `cutebot__set_lights`, not this skill.

endpoints.description: List Home Assistant entity states. Returns up to 50 entities with entity_id, current state, and friendly_name. Read-only.
List entities filtered by Home Assistant domain (light, switch, sensor, climate, lock, media_player, etc.). Returns entity_id, state, friendly_name, device_class.

params.name: domain
params.description: HA domain prefix to filter, e.g. 'light', 'switch', 'climate', 'sensor', 'lock', 'media_player'. Empty string returns all domains.

endpoints.description: Read the full state and curated attributes of a single Home Assistant entity (brightness, color_temp, temperature, humidity, battery, device_class, unit_of_measurement).

params.name: entity_id
params.description: Fully-qualified HA entity id, e.g. 'light.living_room' or 'sensor.outside_temperature'.

endpoints.description: Turn on a light and optionally set brightness, color temperature, or RGB color. Calls the HA service light.turn_on. To turn a light off, use toggle_entity instead.

params.name: color_temp
params.description: Color temperature in mireds (153 = cool ~6500K, 500 = warm ~2000K).

endpoints.description: Toggle a Home Assistant entity (light, switch, fan, etc.) using the HA service '<domain>.toggle'. Use this to flip a device's on/off state without specifying a target value.
Generic Home Assistant service call. Use this when no specialised endpoint exists (e.g. media_player.play_media, climate.set_temperature, lock.lock).

params.name: service
params.description: Service name within the domain, e.g. 'set_temperature', 'play_media', 'lock'.

params.name: entity_id
params.description: Target entity id. May be empty for services that accept other targeting (e.g. zone, area).

params.name: data
params.description: Extra service data merged into the call body.

endpoints.description: List configured Home Assistant automations (entities in the 'automation' domain) with their on/off state. Read-only.
Manually trigger a Home Assistant automation by entity id. Calls the HA service automation.trigger.

Start a vacuum cleaning cycle. Calls the canonical Home Assistant service vacuum.start, which works for Roomba/iRobot, Roborock, Xiaomi and any other vacuum entity exposed by HA. Returns a structured {started, entity_id, service} payload.
Stop an in-progress vacuum cleaning cycle. Calls the HA service vacuum.stop. The vacuum stays where it is; use vacuum_return_to_base to send it back to the dock.
Send a vacuum back to its dock. Calls the HA service vacuum.return_to_base.

flows.description: Turn off all lights when going to bed
